title: senna coquimbensis
intro: Senna coquimbensis, commonly known as the Chilean senna, is a plant species belonging to the legume family Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including diarrhea, constipation, and fever, due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Senna coquimbensis are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
